reviews.title: I do not recommend this app
reviews.text:
This app is supposed to be a kids game to help them learn and understand about the world
But this app has fully turned into a money laundering app where they lock 99% of the game behind a subscription paywall 
Back then this game was a actual game where it was playable without having to pay money each month to At least have most of the features. Now, it seems like that you can’t even use the app without paying the company 5 dollars each month
Even though they offer a free trial They still decide to leave most of the games locked and not able to be played. There is still some fun games that might seem promising but this does not help the fact you need to buy a subscription for the app’s basic functions. Overall this app is not that great.

reviews.title: Poor quality, inappropriate, too expensive and very little activities
reviews.text:
When I heard about this app on Instagram I didn’t really like it because the advert picture was so poor and not very well detailed, Owlette looked more angry than happy

After I downloaded it I was shocked to see that you have to pay a expensive subscription just to unlock everything, without it there is not a lot you can do, you can only color one picture for free, all the coloring tools are locked except for the crayon and the coloring pictures are so poorly drawn that I could do better than that! I even had to screenshot my favorite coloring page! 

Not a very good app at all, it’s very poor and the design is awful and so inaccurate, a house on fire in a PJ Masks game?! Not very appropriate!

And there are far too many ads! There was even an ad about a SEX STORY?! THATS SO INAPPROPRIATE FOR KIDS!!! HOW DARE YOU LET THIS HAPPEN TO KIDS!!!!! I SWEAR I WILL SUE THIS APP AND THE APP STORE!!

To whoever made this- please change everything, get rid of the subscription and make the games more appropriate! I’m never getting this app again

reviews.text: My daughter is devastated. There was a gift button jumping in the corner and she assumed it was a daily bonus like she gets in the other games but instead it was an offer to pay $80 additionally to $13 that I already pay monthly?! I will never pay yearly, never! Even if the discount is 99%! Ya’ll are predators and take a rightful place of apps that will be gotten  rid of as soon as this month’s subscription runs out! Would she have even gotten a gift if I paid $80 today? Cause it looks like the “gift” was for me? “The gift” was to pay you more?!  You  barely add new content! This is not even that good of a game! Primitive art, sounds and gameplay, ya’ll are posing as an educational game but in reality it’s an extortion scam!  And I will campaign relentlessly to bring the public’s attention to these predatory tactics you and other children’s “educational” apps are employing. DO NOT get this, get the Arcade subscription, they don’t try to extract you like this app does!  If there’s a jumping gift it needs to be a strait up legitimate gift in the game for the player, not the parent! After I have paid I never ever want to be presented with an offer to pay again! NOT WORTH $13 a month, $80 a year, not worth getting  free trial!

reviews.title: Really? I miss the old game.
reviews.text:
I… LOVE(D) this game. During age 2-6 I played it all the time! But then I discovered Minecraft. I played it a bit more than Kiddopia. Then I discovered Roblox. And it was even better than the 2! My stepbrother encouraged me to play it, but I had to delete an app to make way for Roblox. I deleted this one and I DON’T REGRET IT! I had a new hobby: reading bad reviews. Then when I looked at Kiddopia THE REVIEWS WERE HORRIBLE! Why do you have 3K stuff but like 6/8ths of it is PAID ACCESS?! (Hehe, I learned fractions) and removed that 12 year old talking, well, most of her. She got replaced my “Captain Kid” AND GAVE HIM THE WORSE VOICE POSSIBLE! 😔✌️
Also, I am into geography, and turns out “stan” means “land of the” and so does “ia” so your app’s name is “Land of the Kiddops” LIKE WHAT IS THAT NAME!? Anyways bye, please bring back the good stuff.
